reasoning: On the season so far the Pelicans are the stronger team; with home court the Kings start about 2 points better, in a game of about 237 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Kings.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Kings (revenge).
Bottom line: the Kings win 61 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 212 and 260 total points.
